pokedexEntries.go: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.

pokedexEntries.si: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

pokedexEntries.cr: When it expands its throat to croak out a tune, nearby POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL gather immediately.

pokedexEntries.rs: The curled hair on POLITOED’s head is proof of its status as a king. It is said that the longer and more curled the hair, the more respect this POKéMON earns from its peers.

pokedexEntries.fr: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

pokedexEntries.lg: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.

pokedexEntries.em: The curled hair on its head proves its status as a king. It is said that the longer and curlier the hair, the more respect it earns from its peers.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make POLIWAG obey.

pokedexEntries.hg: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.

pokedexEntries.ss: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

pokedexEntries.bw: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make Poliwag obey.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make Poliwag obey.

pokedexEntries.x: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

pokedexEntries.y: If Poliwag and Poliwhirl hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.

pokedexEntries.oras: The curled hair on Politoed’s head is proof of its status as a king. It is said that the longer and more curled the hair, the more respect this Pokémon earns from its peers.

pokedexEntries.su: They gather on moonlit nights to form a large chorus. Their cries sound angry and not at all pleasant, but they are certainly distinctive.

pokedexEntries.mo: It’s the leader of Poliwag and Poliwhirl. When Politoed roars, they all cower in fear.

pokedexEntries.us: Although its cries sound like screams, a composer created a beautiful ballad that was influenced by the sounds.

pokedexEntries.um: The longer and more luxurious the curled hair on its head, the greater the number of Poliwag and Poliwhirl that will obey it.

pokedexEntries.sw: At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shores of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by letting out cries that sound like shouting.

pokedexEntries.sh: The cry of a male is louder than that of a female. Male Politoed with deep, menacing voices find more popularity with the opposite gender.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: A group of Poliwag and Poliwhirl will form with a Politoed as the leader. Politoed’s cries make the Pokémon of the group obey.

pokedexEntries.sc: If Poliwag and Poliwhirl hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.

pokedexEntries.vi: It's the leader of Poliwag and Poliwhirl. When Politoed roars, they all cower in fear.
